title: Isolation and Characterization of Apical Papilla Cells from Human Third Molar
author: Ebadi, Miresmaeili, et al.
materials: Dulbecco's Modified Eagles Medium (DMEM), penicillin/streptomycin (5,000 units penicillin and 5 mg streptomycin/mL, USA), fetal bovine serum (FBS), and Trypsin–EDTA (0.25%) were obtained from Gibco (Invitrogen, USA). Dimethyl Sulfoxide (DMSO), Ascorbic acid, and ß–glycerophosphate were purchased from Sigma Aldrich (USA). Alizarin red S was provided by Merck Co. (Germany). Cell lysis buffer was obtained from Abcam Co. (USA). An alkaline phosphatase assay kit was obtained from Pars Azmoon Co. (Iran). DEPC-treated water was provided by Thermo Fisher Scientific Co. (USA). Qiazol and cDNA synthesis kits were obtained from Kiazist Co. (Iran) and Parstous Co. (Iran), respectively. Chloroform, isopropanol, and etanol absolute alcohol were provided from Merck Co. (Germany). SYBR Master with high Rox (2X) was obtained from Addbio Co. (Korea). The primers of COL1, SPON1, OCN, OPN, and CEMP1 genes were prepared by Sinaclon Co. (Iran).

After 4-Th passages, cultured stem cells (1 × 105 cells/cm2) were transferred into a 6-wells plate and then cultured in DMEM-Low glucose medium containing 10% FBS and 1% pen strap [27]. After 48 h which the cell density reached 80%, the culture microenvironment was replaced with a differentiation microenvironment containing DMEM with 10% FBS, penicillin/streptomycin 1%, 10 mM of ß-glycerophosphate, and 50 g /mL of ascorbic acid 2-phosphate (Sigma-Aldrich Co. Louis, MO, USA). Till 21-St. day, the microenvironment culture was replaced every three days [28].

steps.title: Digest apical tissue and isolate cells
steps.instruction: Rinse the apical portion of the extracted third‑molar root with PBS, then incubate it in 1 mL PBS containing 3 mg/mL type II collagen at 37 °C for 1 hour; centrifuge the digestion mixture, transfer the pellet to a T25 flask with DMEM‑F12 medium, and culture at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Expand SCAPs to passage four
steps.instruction: When cultures reach ~90 % confluency, wash cells with PBS, add 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 5 min at 37 °C; neutralize, collect cells into a 15 mL Falcon tube containing DMEM +10 % FBS +1 % penicillin/streptomycin, centrifuge 10 min at 1800 rpm, resuspend and seed at 1 × 10⁵ cells/cm² in a T25 flask; expand until density reaches 3 × 10⁵ cells/cm², then transfer to a T75 flask; maintain cells in DMEM‑Low‑glucose +10 % FBS +1 % penicillin/streptomycin and use passage 4 for differentiation.

steps.title: Characterize cells by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest cells at passage 3, centrifuge 1800 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in PBS and centrifuge again; finally resuspend the cell sediment in 1 µL PBS, run on a BD FACS Calibur to assess CD90, CD73 and CD34 expression, and analyse data with FlowJo v10.

steps.title: Induce osteogenic differentiation
steps.instruction: Seed passage‑4 SCAPs at 1 × 10⁵ cells/cm² into each well of a 6‑well plate containing DMEM‑Low‑glucose +10 % FBS +1 % penicillin/streptomycin; after 48 h (≈80 % confluency) replace the medium with differentiation medium composed of DMEM +10 % FBS +1 % penicillin/streptomycin +10 mM ß‑glycerophosphate +50 g/mL ascorbic‑acid‑2‑phosphate; refresh this differentiation medium every 3 days and continue culture for 21 days.

steps.title: Assess alkaline phosphatase activity
steps.instruction: At the appropriate time point, evaluate alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity using the alkaline phosphatase assay kit (Pars Azmoon Co., Iran) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Perform qualitative Alizarin Red S staining
steps.instruction: After 21 days of differentiation, discard the differentiation medium, wash cells with PBS, fix with 10 % formaldehyde for 15 min in the dark, wash twice with distilled water, stain with 1 % Alizarin Red S (pH 4.1) for 30 min, wash twice with distilled water, and examine the stained nodules under a Labomed‑model light microscope at 20 µm magnification.

steps.title: Quantify calcium deposition spectrophotometrically
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 10 % (v/v) acetic acid to each well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, detach the cell layer, transfer the solution to a micro‑tube, centrifuge 15 min at 15 °C, 1500 rpm, collect the supernatant and measure absorbance at 570 nm using an ELISA reader.

steps.title: Conduct RT‑PCR for lineage markers
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA with Qiazol, synthesize cDNA using the Parstous cDNA synthesis kit, and perform real‑time PCR with SYBR Master (2×, high‑ROX, Addbio) using primers (Sinaclon) for CEMP1, COL1, SPON1, OCN and OPN to assess expression of cementoblast‑related genes.
